# Glyphra

> Unlimited scans, translation and export

Glyphra: Image to Text. iPhone app, available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6809165906?ct=ai_web

## Guides

- [How to Copy Text From a Picture on iPhone (2026 Guide)](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/glyphra-app/copy-text-from-a-picture-on-iphone): Copy text from any photo or scanned page on iPhone with on-device OCR. Steps, an honest comparison with Apple Live Text, Adobe Scan and others, and FAQ.
- [Alternatives to Adobe Scan for Extracting Text on iPhone (2026)](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/glyphra-app/free-alternative-to-adobe-scan-for-iphone): Free and paid alternatives to Adobe Scan for extracting text from photos on iPhone, with prices, limits and what each does better.
- [How to Make a Searchable PDF From Paper Pages on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/glyphra-app/make-a-searchable-pdf-from-paper-on-iphone): Turn paper pages into a searchable PDF on iPhone: scan, recognize text, export a PDF with a real text layer. Honest app comparison and FAQ.
- [Offline OCR Scanner for iPhone, No Upload (2026 Guide)](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/glyphra-app/offline-ocr-scanner-for-iphone-no-upload): An OCR scanner for iPhone that works offline and does not upload your documents: how it works, what to check, and how Glyphra compares.
- [How to Scan Receipts and Extract the Text on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/glyphra-app/scan-receipts-and-extract-text-on-iphone): Scan a receipt on iPhone and pull the text out with on-device OCR. Steps, tips for faded paper, honest comparison and FAQ.
- [How to Turn Handwritten Notes Into Typed Text on iPhone](https://jjjulietttee-jpg.github.io/glyphra-app/turn-handwritten-notes-into-text-on-iphone): Scan handwritten notes on iPhone and get typed, searchable text with on-device recognition. Steps, honest comparison and FAQ.
